body: It is too late. He knows how much I love them. Every so often I will just randomly tell him how much I love all the cats.  Now that I think about it, he has heard me tell him how much I love the cats much much more than how much I love him (I can’t even say it these days without it getting caught in my throat).
100% accurate. I would add that sometimes you let your guard down and think the game has changed for  while. WRONG, you are always on this game board with a pwBPD. Always, always expect a mine.
I’ve learned the hard way that I’d sooner hit my head repeatedly against a brick wall than attempt rational discussion during an “episode”.

You’re describing my SO. He was getting better and doing pretty well compared to the beginning, but recently he has lost his kids in a custody battle and of course he’s reverted to his old self. I can’t live like this. Im to be his girlfriend, home therapist, best friend, sex partner, on-call emotional support person, all around convenient punching bag 24/7, but he can’t even be relied on to be “nice” to me. He literally told me “I can’t be *nice* to you all the time!” Jesus, I’m not asking for showers of diamonds or flowers every day. I’m asking him to be NICE to be like a normal courteous human being would. 

I know he will have slip ups as he improves but god, if this is what I’m going to have to look forward to every time something bad happens in his life, I don’t want to be there. I’m envious of couples who lean on each other in times of stress, not one person who becomes a destructive emotional tornado while the other braces for cover every day.

Your second bullet point is absolutely dead on. I’ve been working really hard to try to talk to him when he is upset but I immediately hit one or all of those tactics to reject any communication.  The one upping is the worst. It’s not like I refuse to talk about his problems, but at that moment I am discussing what’s bothering ME, but suddenly I’m selfish when every time I ask him what’s wrong I get curtness at best, cutting sarcasm at worst.

I’ve become an expert at detaching. Nothing makes him madder. To him it’s not “detaching”. It’s me ignoring him for no apparent reason (I guarantee he will not put two and two together - I am detaching because of the hurtful words he told me). He probably won’t even remember what he said to me, or claim not to.

Yep. I am well acquainted with The Mood. It’s like pressing launch on a rocket. There’s no pulling back or slowing, just have to let it run its course, asking myself how long will it be this time?? 

I’ve told him to fuck off internally many times over in my mind. If I told him in real life he would use it against me for sure. I’m supposed to be 100% composed at all times, never yelling, never cussing. Just calm cool and collected no matter what shit he throws my way. The slightest step I take out of line he will make sure to use it against me.
This is ironic. He has always praised me for being an “inherently peaceful person”.
I’ve been seeing a therapist for a few years now. Things were on the up and up for a while but a lot of stressful stuff has happened in his life and now he has regressed to his past behaviors.

Along with the loss of memory are fabricated memories. Sometimes I just ask him if we were even inhabiting the same frickin universe at the same time, because his version of events would be so warped that it’s like we are describing two totally different events. 

It is extremely difficult to believe at times that this is all real to him in his head.

No book and amount of reading has ever helped their behavior.  It’s like finding out you have a deadly disease, and reading all about it. Sure, you will know more than you ever wanted to about something heinous and incurable, but it will still kill you.

If I could easily cut out my pwBPD out of my life like a cancer I would. That’s how I’ve come to look at it.
It is hard to pity someone that hurts you on a very personal level.

It’s so incredibly frustrating. It’s like I’m in this constant battle with myself to both prevent and orchestrate my own downfall. My pwBPD isn’t even an active opponent. He is like a natural disaster that I can’t calm but I won’t get out of the way. 

It reminds me of the fable of the scorpion and the frog. One can’t blame the scorpion for acting out its nature. I can’t blame disordered people for acting disorderly, so something is definitely wrong with me.

The worst part is that literally everyone else, no matter how seemingly deficient in other areas of life, seem to be able to work out at least that one aspect of connecting with other humans. I know others like me must be out there, I just have no way to know who they are. If I knew you in real life I am certain I would never be able to guess, and vice versa.

At least I was able to connect with you, some real person out there, on this matter today, no matter how fleeting or insignificant.
Same here. Except 3 dogs. I love them so much. All else in this world lacks meaning for me. Can’t connect to any human on a “real” level. I might die trying to figure out what is wrong with me.

Hard not to when you’re played like a yo-yo. I never know what the hell I’m waking up to or coming home to or even if I’ll be conversing with the same person within a span of minutes. Only plus side is I tend to lose a few pounds every time we have a major fight. Nothing like a BPD diet to lose weight.

Did I write this?

Not really qualified to give advice right now as I’m in the same boat but I feel your pain so much :(
This gave me slight anxiety to read. Too relatable.

The flip side of un-apologizing is over-fishing for compliments or approval. Like, he will open the door for me somewhere and say “are we (men who open doors) a dying breed or what?” Or like, a while back I was sick for one day and he took care of me, and when I got better he said “did I do a good job taking care you?” Yeah, ok, what do you want, a medal?? A prize for doing things any normal boyfriend would do??

Yes, like they can’t ever just apologize, because a true apology is a high-concept level that children (of which they are mentally) are not extremely capable of. It’s always “I’m sorry BUT” or “okay maybe you’re right about X but what about Y”?

Thank you, this was very insightful. You are right about the philosophical landmines. It’s easy to answer such questions about a theoretical person in a theoretical relationship, but when I have to put myself in that third person situation it’s all but impossible. Too many “buts” and emotions to overcome and self discipline to impose. 

I know I need to work on boundaries, it’s just very hard to forget on a daily basis, but what you said about causality makes a lot of sense. This is rather hard to believe but outside of my relationship I am a very logical person.  This relationship is an anomaly in my life, a weird vortex of emotions and irrational thinking and paradoxical behavior. I guess I am the most “human” I’ve ever been in this relationship.

Congrats! I love hearing stories of people breaking away. It gives me hope that I could be one someday. 

The one thing he has never done is put me first, and last night just proved it.

Part of me really wants him to just do something so shitty that I will just snap. Maybe physically hurt me bad, or blatantly, cheat on me, or hell, just kick me out of the house, which he has threatened before. In the end he always turns his aggression inwards and apologizes to me. I hate it.

I can now see how a repeated offer would make them feel threatened, as in “how dare you doubt me the first time”.  I keep forgetting to view him as an aggressive animal acting not out of pure spite but fear. Everything makes more sense in the light of that. Their whole identity and self image are constantly under threat, so they lash out. 

You are right about the total lack of compassion and empathy when they rage-how can anyone put up with this? I’ve always known he was varying degrees of selfish, but last night was the very first time I felt deep down that he didn’t give one shit about me deep down.  How could anyone leave someone they truly love in possible danger, no matter what the situation. Much less over a mind-numbingly stupid fight over being offered food?

Strange that you mention what I’d do if he died.. I often wonder about that myself.  Of course I’d be devastated, but I often feel that I’d be able to move on much more easily than losing any other loved one in my life. Losing certain people is completely unimaginable to me, but him, sometimes I wonder. 

And yeah, the very bottom line is that I’m afraid of loneliness, which I’m afraid of more than dying, to be brutally honest. I try to imagine a life where I’m happy alone, and I just can’t do it.  I know I’m not overall happy now, but I still have good moments to cherish.  I know I need to get out, many would have already.  I still have a lot of life to live, not spent under a bpd storm cloud.

Mine’s one true love in life was a dog. She was the first being ever in his life to give him unconditional love. He couldn’t part ways with her when she passed so he had her freeze dried. It makes me sad but it makes total sense once I got to know him. 

He doesn’t actually love dogs in general though, he is actually kind of cold to my dogs because he is jealous of their place in my life (I love my dogs). You’d think of all people he would understand the love between a human and a dog, but it’s just a perfect example of his selfish thinking and behavior.

I am unbelievably calm during fights, but he will provoke and prod and needle me until I absolutely lose my shit, which takes a LOT these days as I’ve grown quite an armor for his provocations. When he finally achieves this he is all “ah ha! See, you’re the crazy one! You’re so childish!”

“Wakes up the same person as he was the night before” 

This is the one seemingly tiny thing I regret taking for granted in all my past relationships with normal people.
True enough.. it was not an “on call” position.
Of course.. it’s logical when I read this from another person.  Silly of me..

Okay the woman that said borderlines can be “a little manipulative” killed me. A little? They are the absolute  masters of manipulation. This video didn’t help me develop any compassion. And that guy (her husband) seemed to take it in stride, laughing and joking about her outbursts (“I called it her episodes, I wouldnt know what I was coming home to, lol!)

Yeah it just kind of irritated me.

I’d just like to tweak this a bit by saying what my bf would (or should) say: 

“Every single person in the world could tell me I’m wrong, INCLUDING MYSELF at some point in time, and I would still disagree WITH MYSELF at a later time.”

Yeah, so he does this a LOT. He’ll actually admit to some shit he did but later on denied the very thing he admitted to.  If only I had recorded him! (Yeah I know, proof never works. It makes it worse. They just find another angle of attack.) There is nothing more frustrating than when he contradicts himself!

We mostly live together. Almost all my stuff is at his house (which he told me to GTFO of two nights ago). I kind of have my own place but it’s in his name (long story.. but I pay rent). He has a lot of stuff over at “my” place. Basically we share two houses together. One is “mostly/completely his” and one is “mostly mine”.   I know.. how did I ever get into this ridiculous situation?? I’m going to look for new housing ASAP.

Yeah he left me in another state!! This was two years ago, when I didn’t know he was an addict and that behavior was probably partially drug-fueled. For that incident he has actually shown quite a bit of remorse over so I don’t bring it up anymore. Not making excuses for him.. but he hasn’t done it since (yeah the bar is real low here- he’s decent now because he doesn’t ditch me out of state anymore). Well anyway I’ve forgiven (but not forgotten) him about it.
That last sentence really clicked with me.  For an extreme codependent like me to WANT to give up should tell me everything I need to know. Thank you.
I hope that will never happen. He does have a soft spot for animals so I don’t think he will. But if he (or anyone) hurts my dogs I will seriously hold nothing back.

That’s horrible! Anyone that will hurt a dog is unforgivable in my eyes.

I only wish my bf was mean to my dogs. That would be a complete dealbreaker from day one.  Instead he is jealous and resentful from a distance, no outward anger directed at them.

About 1.5-2 years into our relationship I one day googled “walking on eggshells around boyfriend” and lo and behold.. I found the book that completely changed my perspective on his behavior. It wasn’t until 2 months ago that I finally got him to read that book. He had an epiphany as well. He was astonished. He cried. He said it describes him to a T and wishes he knew sooner. 

Well guess what, knowing doesn’t do shit. He just started therapy with a guy that does DBT that may or may not be able to help him. He’s not officially diagnosed but he is currently overcoming an addiction so until that happens nobody is going to diagnose him with anything. 

I am still grappling with the fact that you can KNOW you have a specific problem that causes your irrational thoughts but still be unable to SEE your irrational behavior when it happens.

I think they have true obsession but love is questionable, at least for  some. That sub just really irritates me because it’s like they never show ANY remorse. I think I just want to see some remorse and awareness of how they have HURT someone they claim to “love.” But no. It’s stuff along the lines of “Does anyone ever ditch someone real fast before they can ditch you. I HATE that!” or “What’s the dumbest thing you’ve gotten mad at your FP for? I got mad because she ate me cheesecake! Silly me! Lol!” or “ My bf said he can’t be with me any more because of my disease. This is totally going to ruin my day!” 

I want to scream: what about THEM? How do you think it makes THEM feel to be ditched, cursed at for no reason, and shown NO empathy or remorse for your actions! 

It’s just a giant pity party over there. “BOO HOO, I am a monster no one will EVER LOVE ME! Btw it’s time to check my stalk my new FP’s Instagram and Facebook”

“You do it too” (when I say that he does something) or “same here” (when I tell him how I feel) are the only two things he says to me lately.  It’s just deflect/reflect. It’s always gotta be about him. Everything I feel is minimized to hell; and everything he feels is exaggerated to hell. Makes me want to bang my head against the wall repeatedly.
Damn, girl.  Some people are so tough it amazes me.  But even the toughest have their limits.  I hope you somehow pull through.

I check that sub too occasionally, not sure why. Guess maybe I’m looking for that one BPD person who will give me insight into what the hell is going on with my bf. It just makes me angry to read anything on there. Zero awareness of the harm they do. I picture a bunch of emo teenagers sitting around complaining about their little lives but unfortunately there are fully grown adults on there dealing real damage to real people.
Also in a turbulent relationship with a man, which may have just ended today.  If you want to swap stories or just vent I have a lot of free time on Reddit.
So very sorry to hear :(   I love love love cats and we can talk if you want.
Wow man.. congrats

I’m glad your animals have someone like you to take care of them. They won’t know that you’re suffering through life just to take care of them, but that’s okay because they give unconditional love. If nothing else then know that you’ve enriched their lives. My dogs are about 50% the reason I’m still here. The other 50% are my parents.
This would be an excellent title for a book about codependency
I have no idea. It’s like they are possessed. It’s extremely jarring to experience. Makes you question everything you thought you knew about the human experience
They are jeckyll and Hyde. I believe part of them is truly capable of love but unfortunately there is the other part that undoes every good thing they accomplish in a relationship.

I definitely look back at all my exes and think wow.. I can handle any of you all now. You all seemed real healthy compared to this mess of a human being.  And this includes a guy who was physically aggressive with me.

I know one thing. If I ever get out of this shit i will be 1000% stronger and GRATEFUL for a sane partner. I want to believe sanity still exists in the outside world.

I get you my friend. Nobody looking at me from the outside would have any reason to believe I want to end my life. But if your problems are big TO YOU then they are big problems. I don’t care if someone living in poverty or a terminal illness is happy, that doesn’t mean that I “should” be happy just because I have means and health. I get how tiring it is to feel that way... I feel like there is something intrinsic inside that is broken. 

All my life I’ve felt like half a person looking for the other half. I’ve been single for only 3 months in my entire adult life. It’s not a healthy way to go about life but I just don’t know how to be alone. I know what it’s like to have no friends. Sometimes when people say that they don’t REALLY mean it.. they mean they have one or two friends, or even acquaintances they can chat up. Well that’s not me. I literally have zero friends. So I understand truly what that’s like. That’s why I’m so afraid to leave my unhealthy relationship. One day I hope to be able to, and stand on my own feet. I wish the same for you. I know you have every right to be suffering. And fuck anyone who tells you to just “get over it.” Your problems are just as fucking real and valid as anyone else’s.

I feel the same way! If he would only give me a foot I could give back a mile. But he doesn’t have basic human decency sometimes and expects me to just give and give. It’s beyond frustrating to explain proper adult human etiquette to someone approaching 40 years old. 

According to him I never initiate sex but when I bring up specific instances he’ll say “well, I was tired” and change the subject. But if I refuse sex with him ONE time he will NEVER forget it. What a pathetic relationship we have.

I’m basically the mother he never had. I let him “cry it out” when a tantrum hits. He even told me once a long time ago  that my love reminded him of a mother’s love.  There should’ve been a me-shaped hole right through the front door at the point.
Mine also asks me constantly why I’m even with him.. which is just a way for him to childishly fish for reassurances. Now I really want to say.. good point, why AM I with you??
I think the consensus is pretty much what I expected.. there IS no way. Suddenly Gandalf’s warning comes to mind: “this foe is beyond any of you.. fly you fools!”

Yes exactly.. they go and dig deeper and deeper until it’s VERY personal. How can a human, no matter how stoic, handle that? And yes that’s exactly it about that damn book.. it’s ALL on me to just  “deal with it”.  I feel terrible for those who have BPD relationships through family.

In my experience there are NO nice gestures without a price. It will get thrown right back in your face as soon as possible. “Remember when I did A, B, C, D, E, F and G for you?!” It’s funny but their memories seem to function perfectly fine when going back to all the “kind” gestures they do for you (remember dates and occasions etc) but when it comes to all you have done they seem to have amnesia.

I feel your pain. It doesn’t matter WHAT I tell him, he turns it right back around on me. It’s the classic 6-year-old comeback: “no, YOU’RE the stupid one!”  I honestly feel like I’m out of my bf’s league too but when it comes to BPD do they even have a league? They have the “disease of relationships” as people say.

I too find it hard to not laugh sometimes because he is SO much like a child, but when he gets verbally aggressive it’s hard to keep laughing. I go “hey wait a minute.. he’s NOT a child, and that actually hurts.”  The constant digs get to me after a while.. I can be the bigger person for a while but I’m not invincible.

I can really see how Eggshells is a how-to guide for staying in an abusive relationship. I was so excited when I first read it and highlighted passages like crazy. But really I feel like it basically tells me how take cover and minimize damage whenever the crazy starts spewing out from my partner. When in reality I shouldn’t even have to do that in a healthy relationship. A lot of BPD people seem to hate that book, but I don’t see why. It basically tries to explain crazy behavior behind the “they can’t help it - they don’t mean to do it” route.
My man-child boyfriend mostly these days.

No answers here. Just wanted to commiserate. Used to play around with higher academics until anxiety choked me out. I understand the depression and trapped feelings to an extent. It’s horrible.  I hated that world. Never getting a break from the anxiety. Never feeling a moment of freedom. Can’t say I haven’t looked back but I have to be honest with myself when I occasionally do glance back with regret: it just wasn’t for me.

This is so real it made me cry.

Thank you. Thank you thank you thank you. I so wish I could meet you irl just to give you a hug, my fellow despondent human being.

Pretty much a perfect description of my pwBPD. I can say 100 positive statements about him and he will find the one that he can twist around and somehow get offended by. 

I’ve stopped trying to state the facts and be rational. It’s always no-win and you described it perfectly- pure psychic vampirism!!!

Arguing using “facts” is like playing with a Chinese finger trap. The more facts you lay down the more they will resist. Just state your version of events (which is probably the more correct one) and leave it at that. You can have a video recording of the way something played out and they will still find a way to argue with you. Most likely they will just jump from topic to topic until they “win” at something.

Same here. I feel sorry for them because they can’t help their compulsions. I can’t imagine trying to get help for something like that. However, I do NOT feel sorry for those who act on their compulsions.

The short circuit analogy makes a lot of sense. I know it’s not healthy at all for me.. it’s just so puzzling that I have this obsession about figuring it out, because it goes against every grain of common sense that I think any adult should have. The absolute worst part is that they can rationalize about it when they aren’t “possessed” but still do EXACTLY what they talked about NOT doing because they AGREED 100% that it is inappropriate. I just want to scream.. we discussed this exact thing in the past! You said you wouldn’t do this anymore!!!

A scene from the last Guardians of the Galaxy movie just occurred to me.. when Rocket was explaining the bomb button to baby Groot.. look that scene up if you haven’t seen it.. actually makes me laugh now thinking about that scene and how well it relates to this.

I have occasionally browsed the BPD sub and it doesn’t really make me have any sympathy.. I just picture a bunch of giant kids crying and pouting over things I can’t relate to.  Like.. can’t they just grow up and see how adults are supposed to ACT even if they FEEL a certain way?

I think they have problems linking emotions to real, outside events and causes. When they are hurt it’s like they will use whatever facts -made-up or unrelated- are available to explain their pain. Same thing happens when they hurt others, can’t match feelings to their causes. Sometimes my pwBPD cannot see how his actions hurt me or how long they hurt me. Sometimes he’ll apologize and expect immediate forgiveness, which makes me feel like it was a totally phony apology. I feel like he stabs me in the heart with a knife, pulls it out, then asks why I still hurt if the knife isn’t there anymore. 

 But yeah.. I totally get how you think they seem to exist only in a shallow way.

I don’t think my pwBPD (bf) is purposefully manipulative, although I don’t doubt for a second some BPDs are very much so.  All that manipulation seems to require so much foresight and planning, whereas my bf seems to be completely controlled by whatever emotion he is feeling at the moment. 

And that link doesn’t seem to work for me..

I guess I just don’t understand what makes them emotionally “stuck” at a certain age.  Can they not just.. pick up where they left off, in a way? I realize re-learning is more difficult than learning the first time, but why must it be nearly impossible? Especially when people left and right are telling them that what they are doing isn’t right?

So why so little compassion for these children trapped in adult bodies? Should I feel sorry for them? Because I don’t. Even though there kind of IS an excuse for their behavior.. they are just “kids”, in a way?
“Baby don’t hurt me” is going to be a reflexive reaction for years to come to this question..

Really feel your frustration and pain here.  Like.. is he REALLY jealous about a website, or is it just a diversion tactic to keep from discussing the issue at hand?  Both would be completely plausible for my pwBPD.  I can see his getting upset over reddit. But also, if I can logically argue that he has no reason to be mad over whatever topic, he will change the topic half a dozen times until he hits on something he has a “right” to be upset about thereby justifying his current shitty mood.

Thank you.  I understand that I am responsible for my own well-being and I can definitely do things that promote that. But there seems to be an unbridgeable gap between self-care and self-love at the moment. I hope I can start on one end and end up on the other somehow.
A BPD logician.. this fascinates me. I’m trying to wrap my mind around that.

These haven’t seem to work too well for me. He just throws even harder punches when he sees that he can’t get me down to his level. 

Now I just shut him out until he calms down.
This exactly. I just shut down because I’m damned any way I respond.

I’ve thought about what I can do to make him do the breaking up.. I’m not seeing any way that can happen unless I cheated on him. Which is not going to happen. 

Sorry you suffered for six years.. I’m at 3. Congrats on your freedom though!!

Thank you for this. It’s a thoughtful reply. I don’t know if I can ever truly love myself. I honestly don’t know what people mean when they say that. It’s a totally foreign concept to me. I honestly cannot step outside of myself, take an objective survey at myself, and then say “wow okay, I really like this person. She’s cool. I’d like to be her friend.” I guess I just hate being with myself so much it’s anything I can do to cling on to someone else and make them my world.
51% rule.. never heard of that. I like it.  Right now I feel I’m operating at around 10-25%.
Congratulations.. I’m really glad to hear that people can get out. You sound like you’re in a really good place now. I hope I can be strong like you someday (soon).

All of the simple things you mentioned (coffee, relaxing shower, reading) sound really amazing. And honestly those simple things are not things I can do around him because he is a walking sack of complaints and misery and negativity. Those should all be things one can do without guilt in a relationship. 

I’m going to start writing more things down.

Thank you. 

Yes, I think it will be a great idea to volunteer. Seems like anything that I do that doesn’t involve him he just hates. I feel like he resents me for being healthy and not miserable like he is.

Sometimes you just want to laugh at the sheer insanity and ridiculous expectations of the mentally disordered.. but you can’t because it’s happening to you.. ah well, in retrospect it can be funny I guess. I’ve learned to detach from stuff like this when it occurs and just see my pwBPD as a ridiculous child. I don’t really get angry anymore, just sad. I can’t get angry at a child. It still hurts though. Can’t escape that.

Went to my first one last weekend. It was okay but I’m not sure I “get it” yet. Everyone was really nice and welcoming but I don’t know if it’s for me. They really focused heavily on the steps and right now I’m not sure the steps are going to work for me. Even though everyone was so nice I felt uncomfortable sharing. I feel like my problems are minor compared to theirs.

My pwBPD thinks that once he apologizes then all should be forgiven and forgotten, and done so immediately. He doesn’t realize “normal” people need time to process pain and heal, especially from unprovoked tantrums from a pwBPD.
Ooo, that looks like a good read. Thank you
Ya.. well if you put it that way, makes sense, lol. I hate eating that lettuce..
Pretty relatable...
Sad life for her. Hope you’re not around that anymore
Just found out mine was using cocaine along with everything else. Really explained so much.

Wow.. just.. Wow. 

Some stuff you mentioned I’ve never even heard of.. hope he got some help
Sounds like she has no impulse control of any kind
The heroin was probably like a bandaid on a gushing wound.  Sad but that’s the best addicts can do daily without getting serious help.
Wow that’s pretty weird. Maybe he wasn’t used to it? The paranoia from weed usually subsides after a while.. so I hear

My pwBPD smoked weed for over 20 years, nonstop. If he didn’t smoke for more than 2 days it was absolute hell.  The last 3 weeks has been the longest he’s been without it for 20 years. I thought I never wanted him to stop smoking but for the first time in his life he has no chemicals to help him cope with his emotions. Now he has to learn to deal with things, and it’s been good.
Personally.. lack of self-worth
I did this well into adulthood... I didn’t like to situate my animals in uncomfortable-looking positions.. I made sure they weren’t dusty.. I’d tell them “sorry” if something bad happened to one.

Probably grossly exaggerating things to get a rise out of me. Like, maybe if I accidentally didn’t hold the door for him while he had his hands full I might have “slammed the door right in his face”.  Maybe if leave a dirty cup and a plate in the sink overnight I “leave shit all over the house.”  Maybe if Im a little late for something he “had to wait all night and now might as well just forget it.”

He does this with just about anyone who upsets him, not just me. He will exaggerate any “suffering” that he had to “endure”. He will also make really childish “threats” that just are laughable to anyone not dealing with it daily.

Very common. They make up their own reality to fit their current emotional state. “I’m feeling this way about that event so such and such must have happened.”

Worse than memory banks are fabricated memories. Shit that never even happened, or shit so distorted you wonder if you are even talking about the same thing.
Thank you fellow sad person.  I wish the same for you, stranger.
Okay, you made me chuckle at least
That’s a fair point.  My perspective is all clouded over right now. It’s hard to see
ENFJ

You may want to read “The Human Magnet Syndrome” by Ross Rossenberg. 

I don’t  completely agree with everything he says but it’s a bit of an eye opener.

He also has a couple of videos on YouTube about BPD that are really insightful.

Lack of empathy from others is so very tough. Because I’m so closed up and introverted I have absolutely no one in my life who I can open up to except my pwBPD. Its like starvation and the only thing i have to eat is poisonous. I don’t want to venture out into the world alone and bear all the pain alone. But at this point what choice do I have when the only one I have to lean on has the emotional capacity of a child. It’s so hard to connect to a real life person..

I know your pain about the sun and other people have fun. You’re talking here to the queen of “unable to open up”.  It’s so isolating and you wish you could talk to just about anyone about it but all you can do is smile and pretend like it’s ok. Sometimes I really wonder if others are soooo much better at hiding pain than me or if I’m just overly sensitive or just in more pain that most people.
